supersedes.011EA574B826F45B: RETIRED AND VOID. That package described these four actions as active duplicate conversions. Day-level analysis disproved it: neither pair has a single day of co-firing, and neither pair's active window even intersects. The corrected finding is two DORMANT legacy tags and two NEVER-FIRED upload actions. The operations are unchanged but the evidence and the justification are corrected, so a new fingerprint is required.

corrected_finding.what_was_claimed: Four conversion actions were double-counting live lead events.
corrected_finding.what_the_data_shows: NO double-counting exists in this account. Tested every day from 2023-01-01 to 2026-08-20: the form pair (6885463625 / 6498555481) co-fired on ZERO days, and the phone pair (6885576934 / 6498555484) co-fired on ZERO days. Their active windows do not intersect at all.
corrected_finding.the_real_problem: Seven conversion actions are Primary AND included in the conversions metric, but only THREE of them are live. Two are dormant legacy tags that stopped firing 19 and 23 months ago, and two have never fired at all. A Primary set that is more than half inert is unsafe to bid on and hard to reason about.

account_wide_vs_campaign_specific.scope_of_the_change: ACCOUNT-WIDE. conversion_action.primary_for_goal is a property of the conversion action itself, not of a campaign goal, so it cannot be scoped to a campaign directly.
account_wide_vs_campaign_specific.which_campaigns_inherit_it: All 25 non-removed campaigns whose conversion_goal_campaign_config.goal_config_level is CUSTOMER. The other 8 non-removed campaigns are at CAMPAIGN level and are insulated from account-level goal changes.

legacy_campaigns_affected.evidence: A fresh campaign.status read returns exactly 5 ENABLED campaigns in this account and all five are the in-scope Search campaigns. Every one of the 18 other non-removed campaigns is PAUSED, and all of them spent $0.00 in August.
legacy_campaigns_affected.per_action_check: For all 12 conversion actions with recorded history, the count of ENABLED legacy campaigns attributing to them is ZERO.

account_wide_vs_campaign_specific.rebuild_condition_not_triggered: The instruction was to rebuild with campaign-specific goals if an account-level change would affect an unrelated ACTIVE legacy campaign. No legacy campaign is active, so the condition does not apply and campaign-specific goals are not required. Forcing goal_config_level to CAMPAIGN on the five would add configuration surface for no benefit.
account_wide_vs_campaign_specific.if_isolation_is_ever_wanted: Set conversion_goal_campaign_config.goal_config_level to CAMPAIGN on the five and define campaign_conversion_goal rows per category and origin. That is a larger change, would need its own package, and is not proposed.

exact_bidding_impact.today: NONE. All five campaigns run TARGET_SPEND (Maximize Clicks), which does not use conversion data to bid. This change cannot alter current delivery, cost per click or spend in any way.
exact_bidding_impact.reported_metrics: metrics.conversions will exclude the four demoted actions going forward. Because two are dormant and two have never fired, the expected change to reported conversions is ZERO for the five campaigns. Historical rows are not rewritten.
exact_bidding_impact.future_conversion_bidding: This is the precondition. A move to Maximize Conversions or Target CPA would then optimise against three live, non-overlapping lead signals rather than seven of which four are inert. That move is NOT proposed here and still needs far more volume than the 2 conversions recorded since launch.
exact_bidding_impact.risk_of_not_doing_it: If WhatConverts uploads are enabled while WC Calls and WC Lead remain Primary, real double counting would begin immediately against 6885576934, 1068114183 and 6885463625.

duplicate_conversion_evidence.method: Day-level all_conversions pulled FROM customer for every conversion action from 2023-01-01 to 2026-08-20, then tested for same-day co-occurrence and for overlap of active windows.

VOID_REASON: Overtaken by evidence. WC Lead 7643656486 FIRED on 2026-08-20 at 06:00 on HVAC Repair, so it is no longer a never-fired action and must not be demoted for that reason. More importantly the same 06:00 form submission was counted by BOTH 6885463625 (SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM, counted) and 7643656486 (CONTACT, counted), which is a LIVE double count. The correct fix depends on whether WhatConverts uploads every lead or only qualified leads, which is not knowable from the Google Ads API. No replacement fingerprint is issued until the owner classifies the 2026-08-20 leads in WhatConverts profile 105803.
